contact.text_con: Can multiple people use the lesson recording?
contact.text_con2: The recording is intended for one person's use only. Distribution is prohibited.
contact.text_con4: You can, but with mandatory approval from the administrator.
contact.text_con5: What level of IELTS is required for work?
contact.text_con6: You need at least IELTS 6+ to comfortably communicate with others.
contact.text_con7: What if I didn't pass the exam?
contact.text_con8: Your teacher will give you the date of the retake. If you fail this exam again, the training stops until the next payment.
